def transpose(text):
    rows = text.split('\n')
    max_len = max((len(r) for r in rows), default=0)
    padded = [r.ljust(max_len) for r in rows]
    transposed_rows = []
    for c in range(max_len):
        col = ''.join(padded[r][c] for r in range(len(padded)))
        transposed_rows.append(col)
    return '\n'.join(transposed_rows)
